verdict.rationale: Mixpanel exposes a broad set of APIs (Raw Export, Engage, Query API, Feature Flags API, JQL, Warehouse Connectors, and a hosted MCP server for natural-language querying and dashboard creation), covering most core analytics functionality programmatically. However, some UI-only capabilities are explicitly called out (e.g., Session Replay sampling management is done 'directly from the Mixpanel UI — no code changes... required'), and no OpenAPI/full API catalog was discoverable (probe returned 404s), so full UI/API parity isn't demonstrated. Missing for 10: explicit API equivalents for all UI-configurable settings (replay sampling, dashboard layout/design, user/team administration), and a comprehensive OpenAPI spec proving complete coverage.
